name: Chipotle Copycat Chicken
desc: Chicken thighs marinated in a blended adobo, ancho and red onion paste, cooked hard and chopped for burrito bowls.

source.title: Chipotle Chicken (Copycat)
source.evidence: Same marinade (1/2 red onion, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp adobo sauce, 2 tbsp ancho chile powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano) topped up with water to 1 cup, 4 lb chicken, and the same stovetop, grill, and covered-oven methods.

ingredients.raw: 2 tbsp adobo sauce (from a 7 oz can of chipotle peppers in adobo)
ingredients.note: from a 7 oz can of chipotle peppers in adobo

ingredients.raw: 2 tbsp olive oil or rice bran oil, plus 2 tbsp more for cooking
ingredients.item: olive oil or rice bran oil

ingredients.raw: 1 tsp salt, plus more to finish
Water, to bring the marinade to 1 cup
4 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs (or breasts)

steps: Make the marinade: In a blender or food processor, combine the red onion, garlic, adobo sauce, ancho chile powder, 2 tbsp oil, cumin, oregano, 1 tsp salt, and the pepper. Blend until smooth. Pour into a liquid measuring cup and add water to reach 1 cup.
Marinate the chicken: Put the chicken in a large zip-top bag, pour in the marinade, seal, and turn to coat. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes or up to overnight.

Stovetop: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the chicken in a single layer, working in batches, and cook, turning occasionally, until browned and 165°F inside, 10-15 minutes.
Grill: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high and oil the grates. Grill the chicken in batches, turning occasionally, until caramelized and 165°F inside, 10-15 minutes.

Oven (best for breasts): Preheat the oven to 400°F. Oil a baking dish and arrange the chicken in a single layer. Cover with parchment, tucking it around the chicken, and bake until 165°F inside, 30-40 minutes.
Finish: Rest the chicken on a cutting board for 10 minutes, then chop into small pieces and season with salt. Serve in burritos, tacos, bowls, or salads.
tips: Pick one cooking method: stovetop, grill, or oven. Chipotle uses rice bran oil; olive or avocado oil works the same at home.

references.title: Chipotle Chicken (Copycat)
